name: Ataraxian (Aphorite Variant)
source: Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse
book: Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse

body:
These rare beings are quite similar to standard aphorites in most respects, although their origin is a mystery. Unlike the metallic sheen that most aphorites have to their skin and hair, ataraxians tend to be a royal blue or violet shade. They are also more slight of build, with delicate, attractive, highly symmetrical features. They favor simple but elegant clothing and hairstyles, and keep themselves obsessively neat.

Core Traits
Ability Scores You gain +2 Int, +2 Wis. This alters ability score modifiers.
Diplomatic Traits You are good at keeping the peace. You gain a +2 species bonus to Diplomacy checks. This trait alters skilled.
Spell-Like Ability You can use calm emotions once per day as a spell-like ability, using your character level as the caster level. This trait alters spell-like ability and replaces crystalline dust.
